title.narrative: Digital Security and Completion of Reports RAU
Digital Security och Slutförande av rapporter RAUD

description.narrative:
The Research and Advocacy Unit has applied to Sida for funding of 497 350 SEK to carry out the "Digital Security and Completion of Reports" in Southern Africa (Zimbabwe) during the period 1 November 2014 to 28 February 2015.
The intervention aims to reconstruct the RAU website on a more stable platform as the main interface with the public and also complete, publish and disseminate 5 reports on a variety of relevant current affairs issues. RAU will directly implement the intervention.
The intervention’s total budget is 497 350 SEK, and the total is being supported through the Embassy of Sweden and there are no other donors.

The objectives are to support the reconstruction of the RAU website migrating it to a more stable platform which acts as the main interface with the public. Secondly support will also be channelled to the ccompletion, publishing and dissemination of 5 reports on a variety of relevant current democratic affairs in Zimbabwe.
